latestVersion.changelog:
GhostScore 1.1.0 is a major update focused on privacy and safety: all on-chain signing and payment functionality has been removed. This skill is now strictly read-only and solely for verification.

- All signing, payment, and wallet key handling removed — no private keys are accepted or used.
- The skill now only supports querying scores/tiers, listing available endpoints, and verifying zero-knowledge attestations.
- Environment variables simplified; only read-only Monad RPC and GhostScore API key required.
- Payments and attestation generation now occur externally via the GhostScore frontend or user wallet.
- Enhanced privacy: never transmits or requests agent wallet addresses; never exposes exact agent score to unauthorized parties.
- Documentation updated to clarify strict read-only, verification-only capabilities.
